comparison.readability: Hermes is shorter and easier to skim. ResearchHub is more detailed and source-located, but citation density and repeated evidence inventories reduce scanability.
comparison.thesis: Hermes offers a concise directional conclusion but does not state a falsifiable condition with source-bound counterevidence. ResearchHub separates support, counterevidence, invalidation conditions and follow-up indicators; its independent semantic review did not run because two structural sections remain blocked.
comparison.valuation: Hermes has no dedicated valuation section. ResearchHub computes a dated FY2025 historical reference PE with formula and local input sensitivity; it is not a forward valuation, value range or target price.
comparison.scenarios: Hermes has no source-bound Bear/Base/Bull calculation or sensitivity model. ResearchHub correctly leaves the section blocked because sourced target-year operating assumptions are unavailable.
comparison.expectationGap: Hermes has no two-surface expectation comparison. ResearchHub displays current THS/EastMoney FY2026 EPS samples, but marks historical value versions unverified and does not accept the channel delta as a valid expectation-gap conclusion. Some EastMoney sample rows have much earlier publication dates and markedly different scales; this is a stale-vintage/scale anomaly risk requiring source-version review, not an accepted market expectation.
comparison.monitoring: Hermes has risk descriptions but no dedicated monitoring checklist with cadence, trigger, baseline and thesis linkage. ResearchHub provides nine checks with cadence and conditional triggers; some explicitly lack numeric thresholds because sources do not provide them.

limitations: Hermes predates the ResearchHub as-of date by about three months and has no comparable valuation or forecast chapters.
This is a readability and evidence review of the inspected artifacts; it cannot establish the accuracy of unsupported Hermes estimates or substitute for the ResearchHub Workflow semantic gate.
No side-by-side valuation or expectation-gap acceptance is possible while ResearchHub has only historical reference PE and unverified expectation vintages.
